sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Coddia rudis is a dense evergreen shrub, often multi-stemmed, reaching about 3 m and sometimes growing as a small tree. It is native to southern Africa, where it grows on forest edges, in thickets and acacia woodland, and among rocks.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: Its small leaves, opposite or clustered on short shoots, are about 20 × 15 mm. The flowers are white; the globose fruit retains a crown-like calyx. The plate matches the shrub, leaves and fruit. No food use is established.
